A cooking recipe, drawn with the station's own screen from the pack's resource pack ([[Module:Station]]). <code>station</code> is the block used: [[Oven]], [[Mud Kiln]], [[Blast Furnace]] or [[Kindling]] (a campfire has no screen, so kindling shows the item resting on the fire). <code>note</code> is shown underneath; its leading number of seconds also sets how fast the arrow fills.
